title: One picture or line stands for the key
concept: In a pictograph or a scaled bar chart, one picture or one line does not always stand for 1. The key or the scale says how many it stands for.
Read the key first. Then count pictures (or lines) and multiply by the key; to draw, share the number into groups of the key.

alternative.title: Read the key first
text: Before counting anything on a chart, find what one picture or one line stands for.

members.title: Pictographs: each picture stands for the key
Scaled bar charts: read the scale, do not count lines

responsePatterns.supports: every symbol and line read as 1 on both displays: the key/scale idea is missing
responsePatterns.uncertain: none competing; teach the shared concept

responsePatterns.supports: uses keys but assumes scales go in 10s
responsePatterns.uncertain: a habit from charts seen before; fix_assume_tens

responsePatterns.supports: pictograph key ignored, bar scale read
responsePatterns.uncertain: a pictograph-specific reading slip; existing spot_the_mistake

whyThisPattern: 6 families in 5 competencies (pictographs, tallies, bar charts, scaled bars) model reading a key or scale as 1 or 10.
